question: Can the domain-3 inequality compatibility relation be realized internally by sibling CNF transport, with blocks and local candidates recovered from the formulas rather than supplied as CSP labels?

construction_contract.required_local_candidates: the three positive cyclic rotations, discovered by exhaustive signed-map filtering
construction_contract.target_edge_clause: one positive cross clause joining the first recovered variable of each incident block
construction_contract.source_edge_clauses: all six positive cross clauses joining unequal local positions
construction_contract.block_recovery: connected components of the clause multiset common to target and source; no construction block IDs supplied to recovery
construction_contract.compatibility_derivation: test target cross clauses under each pair of recovered local maps against source clauses using the existing R44CA transport-clause criterion

PASS_iff: every recovered block has exactly 3 local transport candidates
every recovered edge compatibility relation is exactly candidate-index inequality
global recovered transport assignments are in bijection with proper 3-colorings on every enumerated graph
target clause count is 4n+m and source clause count is 4n+6m
